episodes.synopsis: What's more attractive: a man with a handsome face, or a man who owns a library? The Crown Prince has both, but avid reader Eli prefers books over beauty, no contest!
episodes.title: Phony Fiancé

episodes.synopsis: Eli faces a horrible accusation from the girl the prince has been spending time with! Her fate rests in Christopher's hands, but will he read the truth behind this plot twist?
episodes.title: One-Woman Show

episodes.synopsis: Eli isn't the only bookworm in her family. In fact, the bookishness of the Bernsteins is well known to the royal family — and particularly to the Crown Prince.
episodes.title: And So the Two...

episodes.synopsis: The Star of Sissel only visits once every three years, and Prince Christopher is determined to accompany Eli to meet this band of nomadic scholars. But mischief is afoot…
episodes.title: The Star Traveler

episodes.synopsis: Christopher vividly remembers the day he met Eli, but Eli can't recall their first meeting. She'll need to turn back the pages of time to remember that long-ago encounter.
episodes.title: The Treasure of Hers and the Prince

episodes.synopsis: While Christopher attends to far-flung royal duties, Eli must navigate life at the palace by herself. Christopher makes it look effortless. For Eli, it's anything but easy.
episodes.title: Hunting Festival and Lonely Official Business

episodes.synopsis: Eli draws attention to herself when she comes to the defense of Lady Anna in the library. And without Christopher, she may have found herself in a ghost story.
episodes.title: The Ghost of Eidel

episodes.synopsis: An apparently harmless prank takes a deadly turn when Eli and Lord Irvin find themselves surrounded by unexpected enemies in the darkness of the old castle.
episodes.title: The Flower Guarding Bug and the Praying Messenger

episodes.synopsis: Eli's marriage to Christopher swiftly approaches, and she still has a lot to learn about the royal family. But will Queen Henrietta's sage advice do more harm than good?
episodes.title: A Letter from the Pearl Princess

episodes.synopsis: Thoughts and emotions in turmoil, Elianna needs to speak with Christopher, but his busy schedule makes it nearly impossible to find the answers she seeks.
episodes.title: Intentions of the Butterflies

episodes.synopsis: Lady Matilda is up to something, and an unexpected encounter with the wily woman will put Elianna's confidence and knowledge to the test.
episodes.title: A Nuisance

episodes.synopsis: Christopher and Elianna have withstood pressures immeasurable, but Sharon still has one more tactic up her sleeve that could tear the couple apart.
episodes.title: The Holy Night's Banquet Where the Butterflies Dance
